_doc: Revert-verify mutant for the BGP half of req 8a0ed10b review H1: a predicate bound from a VARIABLE in a join is matched through ITripleStore.matchExactPredicate (no sub-property widening), so a variable predicate gives the same result whatever the order of the patterns. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders (§A145).
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/infrastructure/sparql/executors/BGPExecutor.ts

B1_bound_predicate_widened._note: The join no longer marks a variable-bound predicate: it is widened when an earlier pattern bound it (bind-first of SP20 returns 4 rows, bind-last 1), and queryOwn through a label-bound ?p reports an inherited sub-property value as own (SP28). Type-preserving (`length < 0`, never true). Re-anchored 2026-10-12 (PR #4557, req 60ed88e7): the join-site computation moved into isPredicateFromBinding, which also recognises a predicate a JOIN substituted (`fromBinding`); the mutant drops only its VARIABLE branch — the same guarantee as before (an unbound variable predicate is a pass-through either way, so only the join-instantiated one changes).

B2_exact_match_assumed_present._note: The join assumes every store implements the optional matchExactPredicate: with resolvePropertyHierarchy:false (a store without it) a join by a variable predicate throws (review round 2 LOW).
